name: Cave Bear
section: Polar Bear and Variant: Cave Bear
sourceWitness: Local first-print scan, with printed folios confirmed visually. The public page viewer numbers pages one ahead of the book.
appearanceEvidence: The printed sidebar describes coarse dark hair. Broad shoulders and the heavy head are visible in the reused Cave Bear portrait from the AD&D Monstrous Manual bundle.
habitatEvidence: The sidebar specifies life underground. Caves and Underdark are editorial search tags for that environment.
variantDerivation: The Cave Bear sidebar adds darkvision 60 ft. to the Polar Bear on the same folio. Carry over its other statistics, including its 30-ft. swim speed.

name: Diseased Giant Rat
section: Giant Rat and Variant: Diseased Giant Rats
sourceWitness: Local first-print scan, with printed folios confirmed visually. The public page viewer numbers pages one ahead of the book.
appearanceEvidence: Matches the shared Giant Rat portrait. The diseased variant describes transmission through bites and gives no visible signs.
habitatEvidence: Underdark, forest, swamp, and urban are tags from the legacy Giant Rat listing. Sewers is an editorial search term. The disease sidebar does not change habitat.
printingNotes: The first print uses +3 to hit and 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing. The official 2018 errata changes those to +4 and 4 (1d4 + 2).
The two roster spellings refer to the same printed variant. Both existing scope keys carry the same rules.
The source calls for one save on the hit. It gives a maximum-HP decrease every 24 hours until cure and specifies no recurring saving throw.
variantDerivation: Keep the Giant Rat’s statistics and traits. Use the sidebar’s replacement Bite with the errata’s attack and damage numbers.

name: Giant Lizard (Hold Breath and Spider Climb)
section: Giant Lizard and Variant: Giant Lizard Traits
sourceWitness: Local first-print scan, with printed folios confirmed visually. The public page viewer numbers pages one ahead of the book.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the existing olive-and-gold Giant Lizard variant portrait.
habitatEvidence: The book places subterranean giant lizards among Underdark communities. The legacy Giant Lizard listing supplies forest, swamp, desert, and coastal habitat tags.
printingNotes: Bite, the associated lore, and the variant box are at the top of the right column. The base stat block starts at the bottom of the left column.
variantDerivation: This existing named scope uses both sidebar traits. Hold Breath adds a 30-ft. swim speed. Spider Climb retains the 30-ft. climb speed and removes the ability check on difficult surfaces.

name: Saber-Toothed Tiger
sourceWitness: Local first-print scan, with printed folios confirmed visually. The public page viewer numbers pages one ahead of the book.
